rows.en: Ai: "H-Hey, what about Leone?!"
Gabon: "..."
Kasumi: "No..."
Miyasco: "The battle just now seems to have put a tremendous strain on her."
Gabon: "Leone was consuming Prana as though she were spending her very life...
That's what it was... How could I miss something so simple...?
To have overlooked that... Ghh..."
Miyasco: "...Please leave the two of them alone for now."
Ymir: "Touya..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "...I'm sorry..."
Touya: "Why are you apologizing? It's not your fault... It's not your fault..."
Leone: "Touya... Don't be sad...
I'm really someone who shouldn't exist here..."
Touya: "Don't say that. You belong here.
You have to be here!"
Leone: "...Thank you...
I never knew loving someone could be this hard...
It hurts, and it aches... I love you
so much I can't help it, yet we have to part... But now I understand
that never knowing love would be even harder.
Now that I know what it's like to love someone..."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "I'm... so glad I fell in love with you, Touya...
I'm truly glad..."
Touya: "I feel the same. So hang in there.
You can't give up."
Leone: "Ehehe... Thank you.
...Hey, Touya..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Leone: "Would you hold my hand?
I want to... feel you, Touya."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Is this all right?"
Leone: "Hee hee... Your hand's so warm, Touya...
Just like your heart, Touya."
Touya: "Leone..."
Ai: "He's... not coming after all."
Celica: "You can't blame him...
With the person he loves in that condition,
he can't just go off and enjoy himself."
Kasumi: "Touya..."
Clovis: "Hey, where are your dresses?
Bart went to all that trouble to get them for you..."
Ai: "We can't just go celebrating
at a time like this! Our friend's in danger!
How can you enjoy yourself so carelessly?"
Clovis: "...Will being sad make Leone better?
If it would, I'd cry all you want. But it won't, will it?
That's just for your own satisfaction.
Do you think she'd be happy seeing everyone look miserable
because of her?"
Ai: "That's..."
Kasumi: "Even so... Touya's hurting.
We can't be the only ones enjoying ourselves...
I just can't do it."
Arthur: "Clovis, you have a point,
but it seems they can't simply switch their feelings like that."
Clovis: "I see..."
Arthur: "Oh? What's going on?"
Ai: "H-Hey, look!"
Kasumi: "?! N-No..."
Clovis: "Hey, you've got to be kidding..."
Yamato: "Come on, what are you doing?!
Hurry up and get changed!"
Touya: "Shut up... I know!"
Yamato: "All right, come in!"
Melvi: "Huh? Big brother, you haven't changed yet?
Big sister, Papa and Mama are already... Hmm? What?"
You're incredibly cute!
It really suits you.
Melvi: "Th-Thank you..."
Touya: "You're still going on about it?!"
Yamato: "Heeelp!"
Melvi: "It's okay. There, there.
Big brother! Don't bully Yamato! Bad!"
Touya: "But she..."
Melvi: "It's a party! Let's all
have fun together. Okay?"
Touya: "O-Okay, okay."
Melvi: "Then hurry and get changed.
I'll wait downstairs."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Melvi: "Ehehe. I'm happy.
But you shouldn't be saying that to Melvi."
Touya: "Huh?"
Melvi: "You're kind to everyone, big brother,
but that can hurt the person you care about most.
Girls' feelings are very complicated, you know."
Touya: "Melvi... Who did you get that from?"
Melvi: "Oh, you noticed? Actually, Mama said it."
Yamato: "Oh, that's it. You surprised me."
Melvi: "Big brother, we'll be late if you don't hurry and get changed.
Melvi will go on ahead."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Melvi: "Huh? Y-You think so...?"
Yamato: "Of course. You look cute."
Melvi: "...I'm glad. Mama made this for me."
Touya: "Huh... So Paldia's good at sewing too."
Melvi: "Do you like people who are good at sewing, big brother?"
Touya: "W-Well, I guess being good at it is better than being bad?"
Melvi: "All right! Then Melvi will get good at it too.
I'll practice and practice until I'm good."
Touya: "No, you don't have to force yourself..."
Melvi: "It's all right. I'll learn quickly.
I don't want you to dislike me, big brother.
I want you to like me lots and lots."
Touya: "I see. But, Melvi...
I won't dislike you just because you can't sew, you know?"
Melvi: "...Okay."
Touya: "..."
Melvi: "..."
Yamato: "Touya. Stop gazing at each other here
and hurry up and get changed! It's rude
to keep a lady waiting, isn't it?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. You're right."
Melvi: "Th-Then Melvi will wait downstairs."
Yamato: "Sorry to keep you waiting!"
Melvi: "Huh? Big brother, are those clothes... Papa's?"
Yamato: "That's right.
Bart went to all that trouble to get him something..."
Touya: "Like hell I'd wear that!
Am I supposed to join a costume parade?!"
Yamato: "Really? What a waste.
You'd look like Amakusa Shiro. I'm sure it'd be a hit..."
Touya: "That's why I don't want to!"
Yamato: "You think so? I think it'd look much better than what you're wearing now..."
Touya: "Easy for you to say. You're not the one wearing it..."
Melvi: "But those clothes suit you too.
You look good in anything, big brother."
Touya: "Y-You think so?"
Melvi: "Yeah."
Yamato: "All right, all right. We've had our fill.
They weren't kidding when they said love is blind."
Touya: "...Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
Hmm? Yamato?"
Melvi: "Come on! Don't fight!"
Touya: "She started it..."
Yamato: "You were the one who raised a hand first..."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "Ghh..."
Yamato: "Wh-What pressure..."
Melvi: "...Do you understand?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Right?"
Yamato: "Y-Yes."
Melvi: "Good! Then we're all friends. Let's go!"
Clovis: "Hey. Finally awake?"
Arthur: "The signing ceremony ended without incident.
There still seems to be some friction in the lower ranks,
but the leaders have reconciled,
so it looks like we'll have peaceful days for a while."
Touya: "For a while... Huh."
Clovis: "Maybe we'd have to become herbivores to get rid of war among humans.
As long as we hunt to satisfy our appetites,
I doubt it'll happen."
Arthur: "I'm sure there's more to it than that, but as long as
we keep living as we do now, yes."
Touya: "Enough, enough. There's no point thinking about that.
We'd probably just end up thinking like Debish,
anyway."
Clovis: "True. So for now, let's enjoy tonight's party
as much as we can."
Arthur: "We're guests. Apart from being bombarded with questions by the ladies,
I think we can relax and enjoy ourselves."
Clovis: "That's the part I'm looking forward to.
A one-night romance isn't bad, either.
How about it, Touya? You could..."
Melvi: "..."
Clovis: "Ha ha... Ha ha ha... I-I'm joking. Just joking.
You've got such a cute partner already."
Arthur: "Oh, by the way, Ymir was
looking for you."
Melvi: "Huh? Really?"
Arthur: "I think she's in Lady Ivel's room now."
Melvi: "What could it be...?"
Touya: "Go see her."
Melvi: "But..."
Touya: "It might be important, right?
Don't worry. I'll wait for you."
Melvi: "Okay... Then I'll be right back."
Clovis: "Well, looks like the party's about to start.
Let's go too."
Touya: "Yeah."
